Gauge 2 Open Wagons


The Gauge 2 wagon stock is a mixture of Carette tinplate and wooden body stock, perhaps by Bassett Lowke.


7-Plank open, wood construction, possibly by Butcher. One of four identical wagons acquired in very poor condition with the Butcher 'Abergavenny' at the SAS auction in 2019.




5-Plank Open, wood construction, origin unknown perhaps Bassett Lowke.From the Rugby Vectis auction and clearly related to the dumb buffer wagons with the same type of coal load.



5-Plank Open, wood construction, origin unknown perhaps Bassett Lowke.From the Rugby Vectis auction and clearly related to the dumb buffer wagons with the same type of coal load. Note modern printing on piece of 4x2 - clearly someone was still running Gauge 2 in modern times!






LNWR 20T coal wagons. Wood construction, probably scratch built. These two wagons form a pair with a type of automatic coupler (very rare in Gauge 2) between them.






NER 5 plank open coal wagon. Wood construction, from the Rugby Vectis auctions.
